decisions.reason: Pinpoints the disabled expression in AttachmentChips and shows that busy is local to AttachButton and unbound in the chips component. Explains that the empty-dock early return and the short-circuit in locked phases skip it, so only a present occurrence in plain phase evaluates it and throws a ReferenceError.

Explains that a render-phase throw is caught by the InputZone slot boundary, which unmounts the whole dock entry. The separate attach-button slot survives, and the error appears only in the browser console.

Uses the v0.2.10 line to show the reference already existed, and proposes a data-present plain-phase mount plus rollback/re-add bisection. Notes that the diff's base disagrees with the shipped file and that imageItem reads record/status outside their callback scope.

Removes the busy reference while keeping the phase guard, and offers properly owned state as an alternative. Moves imageItem inside the map callback, uses (record?.items ?? []), and uses an optional-chained closest or an instanceof check, with a sound slot-insurance rationale.

Proposes a mount test with an occurrence in plain phase that asserts the chip and remove button render and no error is captured. Explains why empty-state and locked-phase tests miss the line and why node --check only parses, and includes the data-present smoke in the pre-ship gate.
